scope: Selected aggregate observations copied from the author-supplied text export. No raw traffic, paper, reviewer correspondence, or model training occurs in this analysis.

selection.layout_pairs_alpha005.csv: all_metrics_round2.csv: alpha=0.05, composite score, 12B and 16Q; three primary metrics
selection.peer_pairs_alpha005.csv: peer_context_metrics.csv: alpha=0.05, owner/peer ideal and peer 1% loss; both hard holdouts and all five seeds

interpretation: R2 is a distinct corrected protocol. Do not merge these values with historical R1 outcomes. Trial-level tests assume independent symmetric paired differences; family-mean sensitivity is reported separately. Nonsignificance is not equivalence.
